question: What powers of desire and time arise in the state of affection?
premises: Affection can be a locus of experience
inference: In affection, there is all-desire-ness and, through time, the turning of all seasons.
uncertainties: The causal relation between kālāt and sarvartuvartanam is compactly expressed
plain_english: But in affection there is all-desire-ness, and from time the turning of all seasons.
